rules.oracle: Attack go again gains one AP at the start of Resolution; it does not depend on hit and is not duplicated.
Arrow play requires Arsenal and a controlled Bow. Pitching/declaring a Hand card to defend is a different action.
An ordinary action has oneAP plus printed resource cost; underfunded asset payment does not commit AP; rejected play restores preannouncement state.
Real Hand declarations contribute numeric printed defense, damage is attack power minus total defense floored0, sources remain through link and clear to owners on close.
